rationale: The new SEN-D1 sensor repeatedly timed out during pairing (120s timeout in logs) despite being within 1m of the base station with a blue SYNC LED. Base station was online with only 5/16 devices bound, firmware protocol v2 was compatible, and no error codes were present. A factory reset of the sensor followed by re-pairing succeeded on the first try, confirming a stale/peripheral-side binding state as the cause.

repair_steps: Confirm the new sensor is now paired and online in the app.
Advise the customer to move the sensor to its final location and verify it remains online.
Close the case with resolution code PAIR_TIMEOUT (L1).
output.customer_reply: Great news! Your new sensor is now paired and working. You can move it to its final location. If it goes offline, try moving it closer to the base station or check the battery. Thank you for your patience, and feel free to reach out if you need further help.
